summary: The prepared base reproduces the ROCm DCP decode return-shape defect in the actual forward_absorb_rocm_core implementation. The exact candidate requests return_lse=True, validates the returned container before LSE use, and passes both its regression and independent adversarial implementation-boundary cases. Real single-GPU DCP LSE combine kernels matched independent CPU references. The reported 8-rank MI300X deployment remains unavailable, but no counterexample to the original return-contract fix was found.

tests.what_was_measured: On base: batch 1 raised ValueError: not enough values to unpack; batch 2 silently unpacked two tensor rows and reached later DCP configuration; batch 3 raised ValueError: too many values to unpack. Backend kwargs lacked return_lse in all cases.

Exact candidate regression: 7 tests passed plus 4 parameterized subtests, covering batch one/larger, tensor-only and tuple returns, absent LSE, return_lse request, and LSE identity at the collective boundary.

On the exact candidate, tensor-only results for batches 1, 2, and 3 all failed immediately with the explicit ROCm DCP contract RuntimeError and return_lse=True was observed. Valid tuples for batches 1 and 3 succeeded and passed the identical LSE tensor to dcp_a2a_lse_reduce. Tuple-with-None and list containers failed before collective use.
Four real GPU Triton correction/combine cases passed against independent CPU references, covering natural-log and base-2 LSE, larger batch, and larger head dimension.

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, ROCm 7.2.26015, torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Four selected DCP LSE Triton-vs-CPU numerical tests executed and passed.

native_rebuild_reason: Candidate changes only Python source, a Python test, and its own report; no C++, FlyDSL, or native source changed.
remaining_limitations: Only one assigned GPU was available; real multi-rank DCP collectives and transport were not executed.
The reported 8x MI300X/gfx942 GLM-5.3 deployment was unavailable; the assigned GPU was MI355X/gfx950.
Model weights and the full server reproduction were unavailable and were not claimed as tested.
The candidate PR body references mirror issue 597 instead of the reviewed mirror issue 669; this is documentation metadata and does not alter the code verdict.
